jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a) inventory: the Addison Northwest Supervisory District's sole district is the Addison Northwest School District (unified union; member towns Addison, Ferrisburgh, Panton, Vergennes, Waltham).
Addison Northwest School District (official district website).

sources.note: Addison Northwest elects its directors proportional-to-town (16 V.S.A. section 730(a)(1)): each town elects its own allocated director(s) on its own ballot -- the Town of Panton 2025 Town Report (published 2026) lists a single 'Addison Northwest School District Board Representative' among the town's elected officers. Seat counts confirmed from town sources: Vergennes 4, Panton 1, Waltham 1; the Addison and Ferrisburgh allocations could not be confirmed from an official source, so no posts are modeled for those towns yet.
Town of Panton 2025 Town Report (published 2026): 'Addison Northwest School District Board Representative -- Martha DeGraaf -- 2028 (3-year term)'.
